mapper.sql: WITH employee_base AS ( SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.organization_id, e.name AS employee_name, NVL(e.department, '미지정') AS department, NVL(e.position, '사원') AS position FROM t_employee e WHERE e.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND NVL(e.employment_status, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' ), monthly_employee_usage AS ( SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.department, e.position, NVL(SUM(u.usage_count), 0) AS usage_count, NVL(ROUND(SUM(u.travel_distance), 1), 0) AS travel_distance, NVL(ROUND(SUM(u.carbon_amount), 1), 0) AS carbon_amount FROM employee_base e LEFT JOIN t_employee_usage_stat u ON u.employee_id = e.employee_id AND u.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND u.usage_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.department, e.position )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(usage_count), 0) AS total_usage_count, NVL(ROUND(SUM(travel_distance), 1), 0) AS total_travel_distance, NVL(ROUND(SUM(carbon_amount), 1), 0) AS total_carbon_reduction FROM monthly_employee_usage

SELECT employee_id, employee_name, department, usage_count, travel_distance, carbon_amount AS carbon_reduction FROM monthly_employee_usage ORDER BY usage_count DESC, carbon_amount DESC, employee_id ASC
SELECT employee_id, employee_name, department, position, usage_count, travel_distance, carbon_amount AS carbon_reduction FROM monthly_employee_usage WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT usage_date, usage_count, travel_distance, carbon_amount, usage_duration_minutes FROM t_employee_usage_stat WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND usage_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY usage_date ASC

SELECT usage_date, usage_count, travel_distance, carbon_amount, usage_duration_minutes FROM t_employee_usage_stat WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY usage_date DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

WITH month_range AS ( SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 'MM'), LEVEL - 1) AS target_month FROM dual CONNECT BY ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 'MM'), LEVEL - 1) <= TRUNC(#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 'MM') ), monthly_usage AS ( SELECT TRUNC(u.usage_date, 'MM') AS target_month, SUM(u.usage_count) AS usage_count FROM t_employee_usage_stat u JOIN t_employee e ON e.id = u.employee_id AND e.organization_id = u.organization_id WHERE u.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND u.usage_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND NVL(e.employment_status, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY TRUNC(u.usage_date, 'MM') ) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.target_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS target_month, NVL(u.usage_count, 0) AS usage_count FROM month_range m LEFT JOIN monthly_usage u ON u.target_month = m.target_month ORDER BY m.target_month ASC
